# Format corpus sources and licence audit

Every file here was generated by `scripts/gen-format-corpus.py` from a synthetic 4-quadrant picture (red, green, blue, yellow). No third-party image, sample file or photo is included. All files are our own work, released CC0 (public domain dedication). Regenerate with `python3 scripts/gen-format-corpus.py`. The single exception to "script-built" is `webp-lossy.webp`, encoded once by libwebp (via ffmpeg) from the same synthetic picture; the pixels are ours, the encoder's output is not a copy of anyone's sample.

`stub-*` files are header-only: they hold a format's magic bytes so the sniffer can be tested, are not images, and are never claimed to be decodable. See docs/testdata-formats.md.
